description: Details pursuant to condition 33 - Vehicle Charging Points (Northwest Staff Car Park) (In Part)  of planning permission 22/3004/FUL.
decision_conditions:
This condition 'C33. Electric Vehicle Charging Points (Northwest Staff Car Park) (In Part)'  hereby approved relates to the Northwest Car Park (Staff) ONLY. 

Notwithstanding a passive EVCP annotated on the' SITE WIDE ELECTRIC VEHICLE CHARGING STREATEGY=P2389_68.5_X_17=REV=P1 received on 13 Aug 2026' at the Northeast Car Park (school/sports/buses) this is not agreed. EVCP details for the Northeast Car Park (School /Sports Buses) remain outstanding.
 Details for EVCPs for the Northeast Car Park shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
